source_note: Original AI-assisted community practice path spanning entry, mid, and senior individual-contributor tasks. Each pinned round is a separate practice attempt, not a hiring sequence. Practitioner review and scoring calibration are pending; these exercises do not certify professional or operational competence.
name: Pharmacy Practice
blurb: Practice a collection discrepancy, transition-record review, and near-miss learning decision.

rounds.title: Pharmacy Assistant: Resolve a Collection Record Mismatch
rounds.focus: Handle an identity mismatch with privacy, a clear pause, and an accountable pharmacist handoff.

rounds.title: Pharmacist: Review an Incomplete Care Transition Record
rounds.focus: Find an unsupported reconciliation claim and preserve uncertainty through a clinical-team handoff.

rounds.title: Senior Pharmacist: Interpret a Near-Miss Reporting Pilot
rounds.focus: Separate reporting changes from safety outcomes and design a modest, auditable learning plan.
